subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the grouped Claw manifest and read-only planner as an experimental core CLI contract before the Claws RFC is accepted?
rationale: The patch creates new core CLI, environment, schema, and machine-readable output surfaces that downstream mutation PRs already treat as their foundation; technical review cannot decide whether that provisional contract should enter core.

options.title: Wait for RFC acceptance
options.body: Keep the PR open, remove the duplicate parser modules, and land the narrowed base only after maintainers accept or explicitly sponsor the RFC contract.

options.title: Accept the provisional contract
options.body: Approve the environment-gated schema and CLI now while explicitly accepting that later RFC revisions may require incompatible experimental changes.

options.title: Pause the core stack
options.body: Close or suspend the stacked implementation until the product direction is settled outside the core repository.

recommendation.title: Wait for RFC acceptance
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open, remove the duplicate parser modules, and land the narrowed base only after maintainers accept or explicitly sponsor the RFC contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest available evidence-backed context across the proposed contract and its owner boundaries, though final product authority may be shared with RFC owners.
